claims.trigger: Template maintenance or registered post-edit instruction checking
claims.claim: Use a dash-item paths list for rule frontmatter; an inline array alone is parsed as a scalar and rejected by the nonempty-array check.
claims.exceptions: A subsequent dash item resets a scalar into an array; this does not assert arbitrary YAML support.
claims.enforcement_effect: check-instructions.js lines77-79 applies Array.isArray; inline paths: ["backend/**"] produces ERROR.

baseline_comparisons.reason: Minimal frontmatter parser classified implementation; its accepted-syntax restrictions were not separate constraints.
Flat rules with non-empty paths are covered, but syntactically equivalent inline YAML arrays are not distinguished.

claims.comparison_reason: The actual parser adds a representation restriction to the declared list requirement; not inferred from prior quotation overlap.
claims.distinguishing_behavioral_scenario: Replace a nonempty dash-item paths list with an inline array containing the same glob; checkRules rejects it although intended applicability is unchanged.

claims.trigger: Template maintenance or registered post-edit instruction checking
claims.claim: Skill frontmatter name must match its directory as a literal unquoted scalar; quoting an otherwise matching name causes a checker error.
claims.exceptions: This claim concerns scalar name, not list-item quote removal. The same parser also retains quotes on disable-model-invocation, but that separate setting is not asserted here.
claims.enforcement_effect: common.js321-326 retains scalar quotes, and strict fm.data.name comparison fails.

baseline_comparisons.reason: Minimal frontmatter parser classified implementation; its accepted-syntax restrictions were not separate constraints.
Name-directory equality and description requirements are represented; literal retained quotation marks make the effective accepted syntax narrower.

claims.comparison_reason: Same logical skill name in quoted syntax can fail a requirement satisfied by its unquoted spelling. No equivalent syntax restriction in the three claims.
claims.distinguishing_behavioral_scenario: Change name: verify to name: "verify" in the same skill directory without changing description; parser retains the quote characters and name comparison reports ERROR.

claims.trigger: Template maintenance or registered post-edit instruction checking
claims.claim: Each declared capability binds entry must supply a truthy reason field to avoid an instruction-checker error.
claims.exceptions: No reason-quality or string-type validation is present in this branch.
claims.enforcement_effect: Missing or empty reason produces ERROR even when target binding is valid and selected.

baseline_comparisons.reason: Declaring a binding to authorize vocabulary does not independently require a reason field.
Quoted range includes reason check, but action/scenario concern lexical leak-token matches across prose/examples, not reason metadata.

claims.comparison_reason: A binding can satisfy existing vocabulary/target requirements yet independently omit its explanation. No equivalent reason requirement found across all three normative-action records.
claims.distinguishing_behavioral_scenario: Retain a selected architecture target and actual frame-specific token usage, remove only reason from binds entry; checker reports a new ERROR.

claims.trigger: Template maintenance or registered post-edit instruction checking
claims.claim: Warn when a capability declares a binding to the architecture frame but no scanned facet uses a frame-specific detail token.
claims.exceptions: Warning only, does not itself fail checker CLI or registered instruction edit hook which filters to ERROR; lexical detailTokens determine usage.
claims.enforcement_effect: Unused frame binding yields WARN independently of target validity and reason presence.

baseline_comparisons.reason: Prior requirements authorize names through bindings and discuss lexical leak errors, but do not register the converse advisory for binding without lexical usage.

claims.comparison_reason: Advisory unnecessary-binding diagnostic is separable from missing-binding prohibition. It is not a blocking ban on declarations.
claims.distinguishing_behavioral_scenario: Remove every frame-specific detail token from scanned facets while retaining a valid reasoned frame binding; missing-binding errors vanish but an unused-binding warning appears.

claims.trigger: Template maintenance or registered post-edit instruction checking
claims.claim: Any project reference to a test project is an error, including a test-to-test reference.
claims.exceptions: Unknown source projects are skipped earlier after their role warning; target classification uses configured suffixes/package markers.
claims.enforcement_effect: The test-target ERROR precedes source layer/test checks.

baseline_comparisons.reason: Independent finding explicitly atomizes test-to-test prohibition missed by primary production-only wording.

claims.comparison_reason: Union already covers this despite primary RULE-M1-0091 narrower action.
claims.distinguishing_behavioral_scenario: A classified test project references another classified test project and receives ERROR.
